post.title: What moment made you want to walk out the door and never come back?
post.body_preview: For me it was when I went to pick up my 7 year old step daughter from school and she yelled in front of teachers/other parents, what are you doing here.  I don’t want you to pick me up...

answer.description: This subreddit is a community-oriented place for stepparents from all walks of life.  Commiserate with others in similar situations, celebrate your wins, and hang out with people who just get it.  It doesn't matter whether you've got a fun story or are at the end of your rope; we are family.
